messages.'Audio and video' downloads a normal vid: 'Audio and video' downloads a normal video file. 'Audio' extracts just the audio track — smaller and faster if you only need the sound or plan to transcribe it.
messages.(Pause stops the download but keeps the: (Pause stops the download but keeps the partial file; Resume continues it)
messages.(the number after the address; leave the: (the number after the address; leave the default if unsure)
messages.About the same size and speed, and it un: About the same size and speed, and it understands other languages.
About the same size and speed, and it understands {language}.
messages.Audio-only quality/codec choice, filled: Audio-only quality/codec choice, filled in once the URL is looked up. Higher bitrate means a larger file and better quality.
messages.Automatically queues the downloaded file: Automatically queues the downloaded file for transcription as soon as the download finishes, using the settings in the Transcribe tab.
messages.Checks this computer's NVIDIA GPU (and i: Checks this computer's NVIDIA GPU (and its memory) or CPU and RAM and suggests the fastest and the most accurate model that fit.
messages.Choose what to listen to. 'Microphone' c: Choose what to listen to. 'Microphone' captures an input device; 'System audio' captures whatever is currently playing on this computer — useful for a meeting, a video, or a call you are listening to.
messages.Container format for the saved file (e.g: Container format for the saved file (e.g. mp4). Changing it may re-encode the file instead of just repackaging it, which takes longer.
messages.Could not download the '{model}' model (: Could not download the '{model}' model ({error}). The Transcribe tab's model ({main_model}) understands English only, so it cannot stand in for it. Check the internet connection and press Start again, or pick another model in the Model list.
Describe what you did and what happened. Your message is sent to the project with the app version and your operating system only: no file names, no logs, no settings. There is no reply; for a conversation, use GitHub.
messages.Download (and optionally transcribe) onl: Download (and optionally transcribe) only this portion of the video instead of the whole thing. Leave both at 0:00:00 for the full length.
messages.Downloading the live model ({model}) — o: Downloading the live model ({model}) — one time only…
messages.Downloading the live model ({model}) — {: Downloading the live model ({model}) — {percent}%, one time only…
messages.Downloads the video's existing subtitles: Downloads the video's existing subtitles/captions (auto-generated or manual) in the chosen language, instead of transcribing the audio yourself. Only available when the site provides them.
messages.Downloads the video, transcribes it with: Downloads the video, transcribes it with the Transcribe tab's settings, then burns the subtitles into a new file named <title>-subbed.mp4 next to the download. The download and the transcript files are kept. Needs 'Audio and video'.
messages.Drop a file here or paste a link: Drop a file here or paste a link
messages.Drop a file here, paste a link, or try t: Drop a file here, paste a link, or try the sample
messages.Enter a URL to load available formats: Enter a URL to load available formats
messages.Every transcription job you start is tra: Every transcription job you start is tracked here. Use the buttons below the list (or right-click a row) to pause, resume, cancel, re-run, or remove it; double-click a finished row to open its output folder. Speed: 4.8x means 4.8 seconds of audio were transcribed per second of work; below 1x is slower than the recording plays. The time left is a rough estimate.
messages.Force the detector to find exactly this: Force the detector to find exactly this many people, or leave on Auto.
messages.Have a GitHub account? Report it there: Have a GitHub account? Report it there
messages.It is the Transcribe tab's model: it und: It is the Transcribe tab's model: it understands other languages, and your graphics card runs it fast enough for live text.
It is the Transcribe tab's model: it understands {language}, and your graphics card runs it fast enough for live text.
messages.It understands other languages and still: It understands other languages and still keeps up with live speech on this computer.
messages.It understands {language} and still keep: It understands {language} and still keeps up with live speech on this computer.
messages.Leave blank for no password. If you set: Leave blank for no password. If you set one, share it with the people you want to let in: they type it into the page's password box, or open the address with  ?token=YOURPASSWORD  added (letters and digits only; the page then removes it from the address bar).
messages.Leave blank for none. When set, the serv: Leave blank for none. When set, the server POSTs a small JSON summary to this URL each time a job finishes (or fails). Loopback and private cloud-metadata addresses are refused.
messages.Listening stopped because of a problem w: Listening stopped because of a problem with the audio source or the speech model. The text so far is kept.
messages.Listening… no sound arrives from this de: Listening… no sound arrives from this device. Check that it is connected and selected.
messages.Listening… the device sends only silence: Listening… the device sends only silence. Check that it is not muted and that this app may use the microphone.
messages.Live audio level while listening. The wa: Live audio level while listening. The waves move with the sound coming in; the bar underneath is a peak meter (green = normal speech, yellow = loud, red = close to clipping) with the level in dB at the top right. When nothing moves, nothing is being captured.
messages.Live text only keeps up if the model tra: Live text only keeps up if the model transcribes faster than you speak. Tiny (the default) keeps up on any computer; bigger models are more accurate but several times too slow on a computer without a supported graphics card. Models already on this computer are shown in bold; greyed ones still need a one-time download -- use the Download button next to the picker.
messages.Microphone off — transcribing what was a: Microphone off — transcribing what was already said…
Microphone off — transcribing {n} remain: Microphone off — transcribing {n} remaining part… (Discard rest to skip)
Microphone off — transcribing {n} remaining parts… (Discard rest to skip)
messages.Naming the language is more reliable tha: Naming the language is more reliable than auto-detect for live audio: each chunk is short, and detection on a few seconds of speech can guess wrong and switch mid-session.
messages.No transcription finished yet. Drop a fi: No transcription finished yet. Drop a file above and click Transcribe.
messages.Off by default. When on, the address sta: Off by default. When on, the address starts with https:// and the browser will warn that the certificate is not trusted the first time — that is expected; accept it once.
messages.Off: only this computer can use it (no f:
Off: only this computer can use it (no firewall prompt).
On: Windows may ask to allow it through the firewall — click Allow. Anyone on your network will be able to use it.
messages.Off: the session's audio recording is de: Off: the session's audio recording is deleted when you stop (it takes 100-350 MB per hour). On: it is kept, and the log says where the file is.
messages.Open the Hardware wizard for accelerator: Open the Hardware wizard for accelerator details.
messages.Paste a link from YouTube or any other y: Paste a link from YouTube or any other yt-dlp-supported site. Available formats and subtitles are looked up automatically as soon as you paste it.
messages.Pick a file or paste a link: Pick a file or paste a link
messages.Pick a file, paste a link, or try the sa: Pick a file, paste a link, or try the sample
messages.Pick an audio or video file to transcrib: Pick an audio or video file to transcribe locally (mp3, wav, mp4, mkv, and most other common formats). The file is processed on this machine and never leaves it unless you pick a cloud Engine below.
Pick the browser you are logged in with. The download then uses that browser's log-in session, so videos that need an account (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok stories, age-restricted YouTube) work. The cookies are read on this computer only; nothing is uploaded. On Windows, close Chrome/Edge completely if it says it could not copy the cookie database. Same setting as Advanced › Downloads.
messages.Port, network sharing, and an optional a: Port, network sharing, and an optional access password for the web page this tab starts. Each field also has its own note below it.
messages.Queue is empty. Go to the Transcribe ta: Queue is empty.  Go to the Transcribe tab and pick a file to add one.
messages.Share on local network (other devices ca: Share on local network (other devices can use it)
messages.Splits the transcript by who is speaking: Splits the transcript by who is speaking (SPEAKER_00, SPEAKER_01, ...). Adds processing time and needs the optional sherpa-onnx component to be installed.
messages.Spoken language in the file. Auto detect: Spoken language in the file. Auto detects it from the first few seconds of audio; picking it explicitly is faster and can be more accurate for short or noisy clips.
messages.Stores a start/end time for every indivi: Stores a start/end time for every individual word instead of only per sentence. Useful for karaoke-style captions or precise editing; makes the output file larger.
messages.Text appears a few seconds behind the sp: Text appears a few seconds behind the speech: the app waits for a natural pause before transcribing, so words are not cut in half.
Thank you. Your report was sent.
messages.The '{model}' model could not be downloa: The '{model}' model could not be downloaded.
messages.The Live tab has a transcript that was n:
The Live tab has a transcript that was not saved.

Save it before exiting?
messages.The live model '{model}' is not in the m: The live model '{model}' is not in the model list. The Transcribe tab's model ({main_model}) understands English only, so it cannot stand in for it. Check the internet connection and press Start again, or pick another model in the Model list.
The live session could not be started.
messages.The output files from the most recently: The output files from the most recently finished transcription, with quick Open/Reveal actions. Stays empty until a job completes; see the Transcription Queue tab for jobs in progress.
messages.The speech model process stopped unexpec: The speech model process stopped unexpectedly.
messages.This computer cannot capture that audio: This computer cannot capture that audio source yet.
messages.To use a link, paste it into the Selecte: To use a link, paste it into the Selected file box below and click Transcribe.
messages.Transcribe only this portion of the file: Transcribe only this portion of the file (format H:MM:SS). Leave both at 0:00:00 to transcribe the whole file.
messages.Turn this on to open a simple web page t: Turn this on to open a simple web page that uses this app to transcribe. Open it in a browser on this computer, or share it with phones and other PCs on your network. It stays off until you start it, and there is nothing to install on the other devices.
messages.Use this only on a network you trust (yo: Use this only on a network you trust (your home or office Wi-Fi). It has no accounts, and unless you turn on HTTPS above it is not encrypted — anyone who can reach the address (and knows the password, if you set one) can use it. The first time you turn it on it may need to download the speech model; jobs will wait for that.
messages.Uses its own copy of the speech model wh: Uses its own copy of the speech model while listening, separate from the Transcribe queue.
messages.Video quality/resolution choice, filled: Video quality/resolution choice, filled in once the URL is looked up. Only used in 'Audio and video' mode.
messages.Where the downloaded file is saved. Defa: Where the downloaded file is saved. Defaults to the folder you last used; Browse to change it.
messages.Which Whisper model size the Faster-Whis: Which Whisper model size the Faster-Whisper engine loads — bigger models are more accurate but slower and use more RAM/VRAM. Not used by the cloud engines or NVIDIA Parakeet, which have their own model. Same picker as 'Whisper model' in Advanced settings.
messages.Which transcription engine to use. Offli:
Which transcription engine to use. Offline engines (Faster-Whisper, whisper.cpp, NVIDIA Parakeet) run entirely on this machine; the two cloud engines upload your audio to Google. Set up keys/models for each in Advanced settings.

{summary}
messages.Works with MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, MP4: Works with MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM and most other audio and video formats.
messages.Writes English text straight from the sp: Writes English text straight from the speech in one pass, using Whisper's own translate task (no extra AI model). Output files get an .en-translated name. Works with multilingual models only.
messages.YouTube downloads need a small JavaScrip: YouTube downloads need a small JavaScript engine (Deno, one-time download of about 40 MB from its official GitHub page, checked against its published checksum). Without it some or all YouTube formats are missing and downloads can fail.
messages.format H:MM:SS — e.g. 0:00:51 to 0:01:25: format H:MM:SS — e.g. 0:00:51 to 0:01:25; leave at 0:00:00 for full video
